limitations: This canary tests the exact provider/request/structured-output path only and never evaluates or authorizes a Seedrop product claim.
With 24 model results, the frozen rate thresholds require 24 valid structured responses, 24 nonempty responses, zero completion-cap hits, and valid exact-contract responses from every invoked judge.

The three frozen cases cover served current intent, explicit evidence-gap refusal, and a relevant failed attempt across all four PR-15 arms and both model profiles; they are not a powered product sample.
Passing this canary authorizes consideration of a repaired full screen only; it does not itself authorize provider spend for that screen or the dated confirmation cohort.
